title: God of War
summary: Kratos and his son Atreus journey through Norse mythology.

moments.label: Meeting the World Serpent
moments.detail: Kratos and Atreus discover the giant serpent in the lake.

moments.label: Brokk's Workshop Upgrade
moments.detail: Brokk introduces his workshop and offers an upgrade to the axe.

moments.label: Poison Scorn Poles Encounter
moments.detail: Atreus and Kratos clear out noxious scorn poles in the foggy path.

moments.label: Sindri Meets Kratos
moments.detail: Sindri appears, criticizes the axe handle, and works on it.

moments.label: Revenants and Raging Beasts
moments.detail: Kratos and Atreus battle fierce enemies along the mountain path.

moments.label: The Black Breath Barrier
moments.detail: A mysterious dark barrier blocks the path forward to the mountain.

moments.label: Týr's Temple Revealed
moments.detail: The characters explore the newly revealed Týr's Temple on the lake.

moments.label: Turning the Great Bridge
moments.detail: Atreus uses his strength to push and align the massive bridge.

moments.label: The Bifrost and World Tree
moments.detail: The group learns how to use the Bifrost to travel between realms.

moments.label: Aligning the Realm Bridge
moments.detail: Kratos turns the wheel to align the bridge to the destination realm.

moments.label: Journey to Alfheim
moments.detail: The travelers open the bridge and step into the realm of Alfheim.

moments.label: Returning to the Witch
moments.detail: Kratos and Atreus make their way back to the witch's house with the head.

moments.label: Freya's True Identity
moments.detail: The witch is revealed to be Freya, who revives Mimir's head for them.

moments.label: Meeting Mimir
moments.detail: The revived head, Mimir, agrees to help them reach Jötunheim.

moments.label: Waking the World Serpent
moments.detail: Mimir directs Kratos to blow the horn to speak with the World Serpent.

moments.label: The Water Drops Further
moments.detail: Lowered water levels reveal new paths and the location of the magical chisel.

moments.label: Fire Realm Trial
moments.detail: Kratos and Atreus face combat challenges in a fiery area.

moments.label: Mimir's Tale of Asgard
moments.detail: Mimir shares stories about Thor's sons and their foolish rivalry.

moments.label: Freya's Past with Odin
moments.detail: Mimir explains how Freya ended up married to Odin and her history.

moments.label: Defending the Path
moments.detail: Kratos battles enemies while navigating toward the special chisel.

moments.label: The Stonemason's Tale
moments.detail: Mimir tells the tragic story of the giant stonemason Thamur and Thor.

moments.label: Boss: Reanimated Corpse
moments.detail: Kratos and Atreus fight a tough enemy encountered near the chisel.

moments.label: Finding the Chisel Tip
moments.detail: The party locates the remnants of Thamur and the magical chisel tip.

moments.label: Fimbulwinter and Home
moments.detail: Atreus returns from burying Fenrir and discusses the looming Ragnarok with Kratos.

moments.label: Burial and Arguments
moments.detail: Atreus buries Fenrir, then argues with Kratos about hiding and seeking answers.

moments.label: Into the Wilderness
moments.detail: Kratos and Mimir track Atreus into the snowy woods after he wanders off alone.

moments.label: Bear Encounter
moments.detail: Kratos and Mimir track down Atreus, who is suddenly attacked by a vicious bear.

moments.label: Transformation Revealed
moments.detail: Atreus turns back from a bear and demands answers about his abilities and future.

moments.label: An Unexpected Visitor
moments.detail: Kratos, Atreus, and Mimir are paid a surprise visit at their home by Odin and Thor.

moments.label: Fight with Thor
moments.detail: Kratos engages in a brutal boss fight against the God of Thunder, Thor.

moments.label: Journey to the Temple
moments.detail: Kratos and Atreus head out into the dangerous wilderness to investigate a giant shrine.

moments.label: Stalker Attack
moments.detail: Kratos and Atreus fight off a dangerous Stalker creature in the snowy woods.

moments.label: Inside the Secret Shrine
moments.detail: Atreus shows Kratos a hidden giant shrine detailing Skoll, Hati, and Ragnarok.

moments.label: Meeting Sindri and Brock
moments.detail: The group meets up with Sindri and Brock in the realm between realms safely.

moments.label: Rescuing Tyr
moments.detail: Kratos and Atreus fight through guards to free the imprisoned Norse God of War, Tyr.

moments.label: Returning with Tyr
moments.detail: The group escapes back to the cabin with Tyr, who is recovering from his long imprisonment.

moments.label: Visiting Jormungandr
moments.detail: Atreus and Mimir visit the World Serpent in Midgard to find answers about the future.

moments.label: Arrival in Asgard
moments.detail: Atreus arrives in the majestic realm of Asgard and begins climbing the massive wall.

moments.label: Defending the Wall
moments.detail: Atreus fights off Einherjar warriors while trying to scale the wall into Asgard.

moments.label: Meeting Heimdall
moments.detail: Atreus meets Heimdall, who reads his mind and tests him before granting entry.

moments.label: Meeting Odin
moments.detail: Atreus meets the Allfather Odin in Asgard and agrees to work with him for answers.

moments.label: Dwarven Workshop Visit
moments.detail: Odin takes Atreus to visit Dulin at a dwarven workshop to check on machine designs.

moments.label: Exploring Asgard's Rooms
moments.detail: Atreus explores Modi's old room in Asgard and talks with the guards outside.

moments.label: The Broken Mask Mystery
moments.detail: Odin shows Atreus the broken mask and explains his ultimate quest for knowledge.

moments.label: Atreus and Thor in Muspelheim
moments.detail: Atreus and Thor discuss their mission and search for a mask piece in Muspelheim.

moments.label: Visiting a Norse Shrine
moments.detail: Atreus and Angrboda examine a shrine and discuss prophecies and giants.

moments.label: Finding the Mask Piece
moments.detail: Atreus and Thor find a mask piece in the lava, completing a phrase.

moments.label: Seeking the Norns
moments.detail: Kratos, Freya, and Mimir discuss fate and prepare to seek out the Norns.

moments.label: Returning to Midgard
moments.detail: Kratos and Freya travel across the frozen lake of Midgard with their wolves.

moments.label: Ambushed by Raiders
moments.detail: Kratos and Freya fight off incoming fire and enemies in Midgard.

moments.label: Entering the Norns' Hideaway
moments.detail: Kratos, Freya, and Mimir enter the mystical home of the Norns.

moments.label: Meeting the Norns
moments.detail: The group speaks with the Norns, who reveal truths about fate and Heimdall.

moments.label: Forging the Draupnir Spear
moments.detail: The group visits the forge to create the Draupnir Spear with a god's blessing.

moments.label: Testing the Draupnir Spear
moments.detail: Kratos tests out his new Draupnir Spear in combat against enemies.

moments.label: Navigating with the Spear
moments.detail: Kratos uses the Draupnir Spear to blow up weak spots and clear paths.

moments.label: Atreus in Asgard
moments.detail: Atreus trains and talks with Thor and Odin in Asgard about his mission.

moments.label: Odin's Revelation
moments.detail: Odin reveals his past and his obsession with the rift to Atreus.

moments.label: Exploring Helheim
moments.detail: Atreus and Heimdall explore the freezing depths of Helheim fighting hell walkers.

moments.label: Releasing Garm
moments.detail: Atreus and Heimdall encounter Garm and Atreus decides to free the hound.

moments.label: Confrontation in Helheim
moments.detail: Heimdall and Atreus argue after Garm escapes, leading to a tense confrontation.

moments.label: Atreus Leaves Asgard
moments.detail: Atreus decides to leave Asgard and return home to Kratos and the others.

moments.label: Hel Walkers Attack Midgard
moments.detail: Hell walkers spill into Midgard as Kratos and Freya fight to close the realm tear.

moments.label: Admitting the Mistake
moments.detail: Atreus returns and confesses to Kratos and Freya that he freed Garm.

moments.label: Atreus Returns to Sindri's House
moments.detail: Atreus returns to Sindri's house to figure out his next move after Heimdall's death.

moments.label: Odin's Secret Deal Revealed
moments.detail: Odin offers peace only if no more Acer blood is spilled, but Kratos refuses.

moments.label: Meeting Fenrir in Midgard
moments.detail: Atreus visits Fenrir and discusses his noble intentions with Angrboda before leaving.

moments.label: Atreus Back in Asgard
moments.detail: Atreus returns to Asgard to complete the mask and investigate the situation.

moments.label: Searching for Thor
moments.detail: Atreus tracks down Thor to head to Niflheim together on Odin's orders.

moments.label: Arriving in Helheim with Thor
moments.detail: Thor and Atreus arrive in Helheim to find the next piece of the mask.

moments.label: Exploring Niflheim's Mist
moments.detail: Atreus and Thor explore the foggy and dangerous paths of Niflheim's workshop.

moments.label: Fighting Hel Walkers
moments.detail: Thor and Atreus battle hordes of Hel walkers in the frozen mist.

moments.label: Retrieving the Mask Piece
moments.detail: Atreus successfully secures the final piece of the mask in Niflheim.

moments.label: Confrontation in Asgard
moments.detail: Frey and Sif confront Odin about Heimdall's death and family safety.

moments.label: Atreus Returns Home
moments.detail: Atreus escapes Asgard and reunites with Kratos and the group back home.

moments.label: Debating the Next Move
moments.detail: The group debates whether to use the mask, attack Asgard, or blow the horn.

moments.label: The Tragic Betrayal
moments.detail: Odin kills Brok in a shocking betrayal, devastating the group and forcing war.

moments.label: Gathering the Allies
moments.detail: Kratos and Atreus prepare to hunt down Odin and rally their allies for war.

moments.label: Journey to Muspelheim
moments.detail: Kratos and Atreus head to Muspelheim to find the last fire giant.

moments.label: Phantom Battle
moments.detail: Fight a challenging phantom creature on the way to Surt's Forge.

moments.label: Surtr Encounter
moments.detail: Kratos and Atreus find Surtr, leading to a hostile encounter with the guardian.

moments.label: Negotiating with Surtr
moments.detail: Surtr initially refuses to help, explaining his reluctance to involve his wife.

moments.label: To the Spark of the World
moments.detail: Surtr agrees to help after seeing the blades, leading them to the spark.

moments.label: Surtr's Transformation
moments.detail: Surtr uses the blades and his wife's heart to transform into his true form.

moments.label: Defending the Spark
moments.detail: Fight off incoming enemies while Surtr completes his transformation process.

moments.label: Surtr Agrees to Help
moments.detail: Surtr transforms and confirms he will answer the call to attack Asgard.

moments.label: Choosing a General
moments.detail: Freya is offered the role of leading the army into the upcoming siege.

moments.label: A Quiet Night
moments.detail: Kratos and Freya share a quiet, reflective moment before the final battle.

moments.label: Reflections on Mortality
moments.detail: A deeply emotional scene discussing grief, love, and eventual parting.

moments.label: The Valkyries Unite
moments.detail: The Valkyries reunite and prepare to fight as sisters alongside the army.

moments.label: Orders to the Temple
moments.detail: The group receives their final orders and prepares to head to the temple.
